steps.label: Probe plain HTTP
steps.detail: GET http://captive.apple.com/generate_204 + http://neverssl.com, redirects DISABLED, 10s timeout. Never HTTPS first.

steps.label: Classify: 204/200 vs 302/307?
steps.detail: 204 or clean NeverSSL body = online (exit 0). 302/307 + Location, or hijacked 200 with login keywords = portal.

steps.label: Parse gateway params
steps.detail: Extract Location header; parse mac, ip, session, zone query params (pure fn, tested).

steps.label: Fetch portal HTML
steps.detail: GET Location URL. Regex-extract form action, hidden inputs, CSRF, TOS checkboxes.

steps.label: POST TOS-accept payload
steps.detail: Merge hidden + CSRF + accept=on. Forward Cookie. --dry-run prints without sending.

steps.label: Verify
steps.detail: Re-probe HTTP targets; fallback ping 1.1.1.1. exit 0 verified, 1 still-captive, 2 timeout.
